lines.zh: 我手里没有斧子，只有拳头。
lines.en: No axe in my hand. Only fists.

lines.zh: 三十个一起走，地都在响。
lines.en: Thirty of us walk, and the ground rings.

lines.zh: 掠夺者跑在前面，我压后。
lines.en: The pillagers run ahead; I hold the rear.

lines.zh: 白天我会着火，所以走夜路。
lines.en: Daylight sets me alight, so I walk by night.

lines.zh: 靴子早烂了，脚还是我的。
lines.en: My boots rotted away; my feet are still mine.

lines.zh: 这条村路，我走过很多次。
lines.en: I have walked this village road many times.

lines.zh: 卫道士该有把斧子，我记得。
lines.en: A vindicator should have an axe. I remember.
The column is long; I walk in the middle.

lines.zh: 我们走起来像一支军队。
lines.en: We sound like an army when we walk.
Don't count us. You will lose track.
Empty arms feel wrong.

lines.zh: 我踩过的石头会翻过来。
lines.en: Stones turn over where I step.
We need no torches to walk at night.
The village is ahead. Slow down.
No order came, and the ranks never broke.
Empty hands want something to grip.
A pillager grinds its teeth nearby.
The gravekeeper stands like a post.
Twenty-four points of health. Not much.
I remember the grain of an axe handle.
The night is so still I hear my bones.
Torchlight. I am not fond of it.
Stand long enough and dawn comes.
We are many, and we say little.
Not tall, but bold.

lines.zh: 你看我的手做什么？空的。
lines.en: Why look at my hands? They are empty.

lines.zh: 活人站在我们中间，很显眼。
lines.en: A living one among us stands out.
Nice axe. Lend it to me?
Don't tense up. We haven't started.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我们围住了。
lines.en: We have your shadow surrounded.
That look. I have seen it many times.

lines.zh: 你退到守灵人那边去了。
lines.en: You backed toward the gravekeeper.
I don't know you; the column does.

lines.zh: 抬起头，让我看看你的脸。
lines.en: Lift your head. Let me see your face.
One blow will not break the column.
No armor. Suit yourself.
A bone cracked; my hand still moves.
You strike faster than I do.
The column has marked that blow.
Not the hands; I still have grabbing to do.
It hurts, but the formation holds.
Twenty-four points. Enough for a while.
I gave half a step. The column did not.
Your aim is true; your weight is not.
The undead do not eat.
I cannot hold what you are holding up.
Don't coax me; I am no beast.

lines.zh: 我要的是斧子，不是面包。
lines.en: I want an axe, not bread.
Food would fall to the ground. Waste.
Put it away. I have a column to rejoin.
I cannot smell anything anymore.
That ration is yours; the column is not hungry.
My hands are empty, but not for that.

lines.zh: 吃的换不走我在第三排。
lines.en: Food will not buy my place in the third rank.
Shove me and you shove thirty.
Stand firm; the column is moving.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟压住我的脚背。
lines.en: Your heel is pressing on my instep.
No armor, but I stand firm.
Move; there are more behind me.
That shove sent you back two steps.
Empty arms, hard shoulders.
Don't crowd the gravekeeper; it yields nothing.
A shoulder shifted. I can still march.
Push again and I grab you.
The column waits for no one and yields no road.
Squeeze in and you take the last place.
We form ranks, not pairs.
The dead keep no such customs.
You have the wrong column.
Empty hands hold no one either.
My companions are all in the column.
The heart stopped, and the words with it.
Stay back; I am covered in earth.
I never managed it while alive, either.
Go on; I am returning to the ranks.
Among thirty, there is no such one.
I have no pockets. Don't drop it for me.
We do not pick things off the ground.
Is that essence? Put it down.
Empty hands keep the line straight.
I cannot hold it; my fingers have stiffened.
Let the gravekeeper collect it.

lines.zh: 你掉了东西，队伍看见了。
lines.en: You dropped something. The column saw.
Pick it up and you fall out of line.
Relics should be buried, not carried.
I drop an essence too, when I fall.
The column has turned toward you.

lines.zh: 你站在我们中间，太久了。
lines.en: You have stood among us too long.
The pillagers go first. I follow.
Don't run; thirty of us split to chase.
I have no axe. I am enough.
You broke our formation.

lines.zh: 守灵人点头了，就是你了。
lines.en: The gravekeeper nodded. It is you.
The life in you cannot be hidden.
The village is one short tonight.

lines.zh: 我盯上你，队伍也盯上你。
lines.en: I have marked you, and so has the column.
One glance back and it is too late.
No road ahead; we are blocking it.
My hands have been empty too long.

lines.zh: 你说一句话，我们就开始。
lines.en: Say one word and we begin.

lines.zh: 队伍停下来了，就在你门口。
lines.en: The column halts at your door.
You retreat; the column advances.
We have closed into a half circle.
Not toward the gravekeeper.

lines.zh: 你的斧子只有一个方向。
lines.en: Your axe only faces one way.

lines.zh: 我在你左边，掠夺者在右。
lines.en: I am on your left; a pillager on your right.
Can you count us?
Dawn is near. We must be quick.

lines.zh: 隔十步，我也听得见你喘。
lines.en: Ten paces off, I still hear you gasp.
Don't hide behind the door; it will open.
The column has sealed the crossing.
Standing empty-handed can still frighten.
One step from you, three from us.
A heartbeat that quick cannot be hidden.
A wall ahead, and us behind.
We spread along the wall base.
One step back from you, one step in from us.
I don't raise a hand; the column holds.
The door behind you is already shut.
A fist lands heavy enough.
That one was for the column.
You fall back; the ranks press in.
I have your collar.
No axe, so I use bone.
I strike slowly, but I don't stop.
Your armor stopped the first blow.
Don't struggle; struggling hurts more.
Empty hands, strength intact.
Remember this fist in your ribs.
I shove you toward the gravekeeper.
Bone hits your face with a dull sound.
Stand again and I strike again.
There are many of us. You cannot hit us all.
I ram you into the doorframe with my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的胳膊往回拽。
lines.en: I grab your arm and haul you back.

lines.zh: 我们从土里一起站起来。
lines.en: We rise out of the soil together.
The gravekeeper ahead, me behind.
Thirty of us. One night is enough.

lines.zh: 我没有斧，出来时就没有。
lines.en: No axe. I came out without one.
Daylight burns me, so I come out at night.
The earth pressed my bones sore.
Who lined the column up so neatly?

lines.zh: 我听见村里的钟，很久没响。
lines.en: I hear the village bell. Long silent.
My place is in the third rank.
The pillagers have already run ahead.
The fallen essence in my chest is cold.
When I came out, the sky was black.
Tonight we do not scatter.

lines.zh: 我拍拍身上的土，站直了。
lines.en: I brush off the earth and stand straight.
When fire takes me, I remember sunrise.
Dropping from a height scatters bones.
Fists swing poorly underwater.
The blast broke our formation.
An arrow in my shoulder will not come out.
A spell pins me where I stand.
I need no food, only to stand.
Lightning struck and the ranks scattered.
The void takes one out of the column.
